text:
The UK Commission for Employment and Skills (UKCES) is running a programme of competitions that target specific workforce development problems. UKCES will support employers to develop solutions to identified problems. This guidance documents explains what employers are expected to invest in projects and the level of support they can expect to receive.

This is one of six separate UKCES Futures Programme guidance documents. The other five are:

Engaging a wide range of employers

Potential for impact

Innovation

Types of project

Testing and shared learning

You can download all the content in a single UK Future Programme guidance document.

There is an additional guide which provides information on the assessment criteria.

For more information please visit the UK Futures Programme introduction page.
